Sample.evidence_source: Twenty-nine suicides were reported to the project over a period of approximately eighteen months (2006/2007). In two cases the relatives did not want to take part in the interview, in three cases it was impossible to obtain information about the relatives, and in one case the cause of death was uncertain. The study therefore comprises 23 suicides: four women and 19 men aged between 65 and 90.
Sample.warning: The qualitative sample size (number of informants) is not explicitly stated as a single number.

Country.evidence_source: A total of 172 municipal medical officers in ten counties in southern Norway were asked to report regularly to the project manager all definite suicides among those aged over 65 in their region.

Population.evidence_source: The study therefore comprises 23 suicides: four women and 19 men aged between 65 and 90.

Type.evidence_source: Written information on the project and a request to take part in the interview were sent to potential informants. On receipt of written informed consent to participate, the project manager contacted the informants and arranged the interview.

Area.evidence_source: This section describes the sampling and recruitment process, not the findings related to risk or recovery factors.
